mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings growth and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and increase in the federal funds rate signals a contraction in the housing sector amid monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions characterized by strong GDP growth, the S&P 500 typically experiences mean reversion as valuations become stretched, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 is above its 5-year moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core CPI above 240.0 signals persistent inflationary pressures, which typically triggers monetary tightening and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous slowdown in employment growth and decline in industrial production signals a broad-based economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS and INDPRO both decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1000.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes a slowdown in overall economic activity and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production relative to historical averages indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
